name: Desi Fantasy (Indic Lore)
description: High fantasy drawing from Indian mythology, folklore, Yakshas, Asuras, and magic.

chapters.title: The Hidden World
chapters.description: The protagonist discovers that the myths are real; the veil is lifted.

chapters.title: The Awakening
chapters.description: Discovering latent magical abilities tied to a specific bloodline or karma.

chapters.title: The Gurukul
chapters.description: A magical school or hidden enclave where they learn to control their power.

chapters.title: The Prophesied Threat
chapters.description: An ancient evil (an Asura or dark sorcerer) is waking up.

chapters.title: The Quest for the Artifact
chapters.description: Searching for a mythical weapon or text (e.g., the Brahmastra).

chapters.title: The Forest of Illusions
chapters.description: Navigating a magical, treacherous landscape (like the Dandakaranya).

chapters.title: The Temptation
chapters.description: The antagonist offers the protagonist exactly what they desire.

chapters.title: The Descent into Patala
chapters.description: Journeying into the underworld or a dark realm to retrieve something lost.

chapters.title: The Ultimate Sacrifice
chapters.description: Giving up a piece of their humanity or a loved one to gain power.

chapters.title: The War of the Worlds
chapters.description: The magical conflict spills over into the mortal realm.

chapters.title: The Balance Restored
chapters.description: Defeating the threat not by killing, but by restoring cosmic balance.

chapters.title: The New Guardian
chapters.description: The protagonist accepts their eternal duty to watch the veil.
